item: Which SF units are rent-controlled

notes: Rent control + just-cause eviction. Rents reset to market when a unit is voluntarily vacated (Costa-Hawkins vacancy decontrol). Owner move-in evictions are a just cause but carry strict conditions - consult the Rent Board (415-252-4600).
